regime_context: The detector shows a heavily concentrated, one-narrative China A-share tape dominated by Banks (score 0.907, eligible, crowded, breadth 0.833), with only 2 of 22 themes passing the absolute-trend gate. Critically, this market's backtest verdict says the trend gate did NOT help here (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the sole validated edge is absent for this market — so the entire allocation layer is experimental/display and the rank is a focus lens, not alpha. Given the weak directional track record (dir_accuracy 0.373) and the guardrail prohibiting directional certainty, I offer only a small number of low-conviction, falsifiable leans.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the one-narrative Banks structure breaks by breadth: if Banks breadth_t30 falls below 0.7 while CSI 300 still holds the trend gate, the regime remains single-theme but loses cohesion — if a second theme (e.g. Coal or Defense) posts an eligible gate pass with rising score for 5 consecutive sessions, the handoff would be CONFIRMED and a lean on that theme would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible, scorable theme with strong trend health (hurst=trend), high durability (0.75), and broad participation (breadth 0.833). The absolute-trend gate pass is the one discipline that historically helps elsewhere, even if its backtest here is weak. The rank itself is treated only as a focus lens, so this is not a rank-based buy.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag (crowded=true, z=1.82) is real and, per guardrails, fading the leader is a documented failure mode — but the tape is already one-narrative and mean-reverting, so a Banks shake-out could hit the whole benchmark hard.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by 4% over any 10-session rolling window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO shows eligibility (eligible=true) but with mixed trend health (hurst=mixed), weak breadth (0.429), a crowded flag (z=1.35), and near the bottom of the leaderboard (rank 9, score 0.16). The one validated edge — trend-gate drawdown control — is not backtested well on this market, and the detector's coincident texture argues against conviction here.
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO may mean-revert off oversold conditions; the crowded flag itself is only a size-down caution, not a short signal, so an active 'avoid' could miss a bounce.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by 3% over a 10-session period before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
